    left_beams.append(b1)
    y_lower2 = 2.0
    b2 = sandbox.add_beam(x_left, y_lower2, beam_w, beam_h_lower, angle=0, density=density)
    sandbox.set_material_properties(b2, restitution=0.05)
    left_beams.append(b2)
    # Middle band (2.5-5)
    y_mid1 = 3.0
    b3 = sandbox.add_beam(x_left, y_mid1, beam_w, beam_h_middle, angle=0, density=density)
    sandbox.set_material_properties(b3, restitution=0.05)
    left_beams.append(b3)
    y_mid2 = 3.5
    b4 = sandbox.add_beam(x_left, y_mid2, beam_w, beam_h_middle, angle=0, density=density)
    sandbox.set_material_properties(b4, restitution=0.05)
    left_beams.append(b4)
    y_mid3 = 4.0
    b5 = sandbox.add_beam(x_left, y_mid3, beam_w, beam_h_middle, angle=0, density=density)
    sandbox.set_material_properties(b5, restitution=0.05)
    left_beams.append(b5)
    # Upper band (5-7.5)
    y_upper1 = 6.0
    b6 = sandbox.add_beam(x_left, y_upper1, beam_w, beam_h_upper, angle=0, density=density)
    sandbox.set_material_properties(b6, restitution=0.05)
    left_beams.append(b6)
    y_upper2 = 6.5
    b7 = sandbox.add_beam(x_left, y_upper2, beam_w, beam_h_upper, angle=0, density=density)
    sandbox.set_material_properties(b7, restitution=0.05)
    left_beams.append(b7)
    
    # Middle strip beam (middle band)
    middle_beam = sandbox.add_beam(x_middle, 3.5, beam_w, beam_h_middle, angle=0, density=density)
    sandbox.set_material_properties(middle_beam, restitution=0.05)
    
    # Right strip beams
    right_beams = []
    # Lower band (0.5-2.5)
    y_lower_right = 1.5
    b9 = sandbox.add_beam(x_right, y_lower_right, beam_w, beam_h_lower, angle=0, density=density)
    sandbox.set_material_properties(b9, restitution=0.05)
    right_beams.append(b9)
    # Upper band (5-7.5)
    y_upper_right = 6.5
    b11 = sandbox.add_beam(x_right, y_upper_right, beam_w, beam_h_upper, angle=0, density=density)
    sandbox.set_material_properties(b11, restitution=0.05)
    right_beams.append(b11)
    
    # Connect left strip beams
    for i in range(1, len(left_beams)):
        y_anchor = (left_beams[i].position.y + left_beams[i-1].position.y) / 2
        sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[i], left_beams[i-1], (x_left, y_anchor), type='rigid')
    
    # Connect middle beam to left strip's middle beam (b5)
    anchor_left_mid_y = (left_beams[-1].position.y + middle_beam.position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[-1], middle_beam, (x_middle, anchor_left_mid_y), type='rigid')
    
    # Connect middle beam to right strip's lower beam (b9)
    anchor_mid_right_y = (middle_beam.position.y + right_beams[0].position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(middle_beam, right_beams[0], (x_right, anchor_mid_right_y), type='rigid')
    
    # Connect right strip beams
    for i in range(1, len(right_beams)):
        y_anchor = (right_beams[i].position.y + right_beams[i-1].position.y) / 2
        sandbox.add_joint(right_beams[i], right_beams[i-1], (x_right, y_anchor), type='rigid')
    
    # Cross-connect lower left and lower right
    y_anchor_cross_lower = (left_beams[0].position.y + right_beams[0].position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[0], right_beams[0], (13.0, y_anchor_cross_lower), type='rigid')
    
    # Cross-connect upper left and upper right
    y_anchor_cross_upper = (left_beams[-1].position.y + right_beams[-1].position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[-1], right_beams[-1], (13.0, y_anchor_cross_upper), type='rigid')
    
    return left_beams[0]
